posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina shared the first photo of baby Vihaan Kaushal, sending heartfelt birthday greetings to 'papa' Vicky Kaushal. Fans are gushing over her radiant 'momma glow' post.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's Imtiaz Ali film 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' hits theatres June 12. Meanwhile, Badshah made a surprise appearance at his Dil-Luminati Tour London show, performing their hit 'Naina' together.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia's YRF Spy Universe film 'Alpha' with Sharvari is building major buzz ahead of its July 10 release. Shah Rukh Khan's Pathaan cameo has fans excited for the spy franchise crossover.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka is deep into filming SS Rajamouli's 'Varanasi' with Mahesh Babu, with six months of shooting still pending. She shared relaxing Sunday vibes from Hyderabad between shoots.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's action thriller 'King' with Deepika Padukone is in full production, with a confirmed 2026 release. Buzz is also strong around his expected Pathaan cameo in Alia's 'Alpha'.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena welcomed Katrina Kaif to the 'mamma club' with a sweet message after baby Vihaan's arrival. A viral photo of her sitting with Katrina and Alia together had fans in a frenzy.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: After Stree 2's blockbuster run, Shraddha signed a Rs 17 crore deal for a high-concept thriller with Ekta Kapoor, directed by Tumbbad's Rahi Anil Barve. Stree 3 is also in the pipeline.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is filming SRK's 'King' using a body double for stunts due to her pregnancy. She also has a major role in Atlee's mega-budget 'Raka' alongside Allu Arjun. Sai Pallavi replaces her in Kalki 2.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: After the historic success of the Dhurandhar films, Ranveer's next big project 'Pralay' — a Rs 300 crore post-apocalyptic thriller — begins shooting in August 2026.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: The former beauty queen remains one of Bollywood's most-discussed figures. Fans are eagerly awaiting her next project announcement after taking a step back from the limelight.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika's 'Cocktail 2' with Shahid Kapoor just topped IMDb's most-anticipated Indian film list of 2026 ahead of its June 19 release. She's also playing a fierce villain in Atlee's A6 with Allu Arjun.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's action comedy 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' releases June 19. She revealed Sai Pallavi was the original choice for the lead, but the makers tailored the role for her production banner Tralala.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's mega-budget Atlee film 'A6/Raka' is being called the 'Avatar of India' — a VFX-rich action spectacle co-starring Deepika Padukone, Rashmika, and Janhvi Kapoor. Targeting a 2027 release.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's 'Peddi' crossed ₹200 crore worldwide in just 4 days, making it one of 2026's biggest openers. The sports action drama is his third film to achieve the milestone after RRR.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR is shooting Prashanth Neel's action drama 'Dragon' and prepping for his Bollywood debut in 'War 2' with Hrithik Roshan (August 14 release). Devara 2's future remains uncertain.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is riding high as Ram Charan's 'Peddi' crosses ₹200 crore in its opening weekend. The sports drama sparked some controversy over her character's portrayal, but box office numbers keep soaring.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya continues to be a social media favourite and was part of the Karan Johar Instagram unfollow drama. She was spotted visiting Anil Kapoor's home to pay respects after his mother's passing.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: New mom Kiara is enjoying life with baby Saraayah Malhotra, calling 2025 'a year of firsts.' She's set to return to screens as Nadia in Yash's gangster saga 'Toxic' when it finally gets a release date.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik is making his directorial debut with 'Krrish 4' — Priyanka Chopra has been locked to reprise her role as Priya. He'll also make a special appearance in Alia's 'Alpha' as Major Kabir Dhaliwal.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' released June 5, marking his father David Dhawan's final directorial venture. The rom-com saw a significant box office surge on its opening Sunday.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: The playback queen continues her concert tour across multiple cities. Shreya remains one of Bollywood's most in-demand voices with songs lined up for several major 2026 releases.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman performed at the iconic Attari Border on June 7 in a special tribute to BSF personnel, tied to the upcoming Imtiaz Ali film 'Main Vaapas Aaunga.' He paid tribute to the late Asha Bhosle.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's farewell film 'Jana Nayagan' remains in release limbo after piracy leaks and certification delays. Makers KVN Productions are refunding distributors and planning a solo theatrical release.
